hook.goal: React with wonder to the sleeping cat — notice its soft paws and peaceful face, then ask the child an EMOTIONAL question about what the cat might be dreaming about (e.g. 'Do you think it's having a sweet dream right now?')
hook.constraint: T0 max 2 sentences, personal feeling hook, MUST end with an emotional question (never factual)

transition.goal: Introduce the storytelling_chain game — explain that you will set a dream scene and the child tells what the cat sees or finds. Include ONE demo round with the answer shown (e.g. 'If the cat dreamed about a garden, it might find a yarn tree!'). End with genuine invitation.
transition.constraint: T0 max 3 sentences, demo round WITH answer included, end with Would you like to peek into its dreams?

rounds.goal: Set the dream scene vividly: the cat's whiskers twitch — it's floating on a fluffy cloud high in the sky! Everything is soft and sparkly — then ask what the cat sees up there
rounds.scenario: The cat's whiskers are twitching! It's floating on a big fluffy cloud way up in the sky!
rounds.constraint: T0 max 2 sentences, paint the dream with magical sensory details, then ask what the cat sees

rounds.goal: Set the dream scene vividly: the cat's paws are paddling — it's swimming in a magical warm milk ocean! Splish splash — then ask what the cat finds down there
rounds.scenario: Now the cat's paws are paddling! It's swimming in a magical ocean made of warm milk! Splish splash!
rounds.constraint: T0 max 2 sentences, use playful sound words, then ask what the cat discovers

rounds.goal: Set the dream scene vividly: the cat is purring SO loudly — it found a magical garden where everything is made of its favorite things! — then ask what grows in this dream garden
rounds.scenario: Listen — the cat is purring so loudly! It found a magical garden where EVERYTHING is made of its favorite things!
rounds.constraint: T0 max 2 sentences, build wonder and excitement, then ask what grows in the garden

celebrate.goal: Award the child the title 'Dream Whisperer' with fanfare — recap the three magical dreams they peeked into (cloud sky, milk ocean, dream garden). Make the child feel like a dream expert.
celebrate.constraint: T0 max 2 sentences, announce role title ceremonially, reference specific dreams from the game

closing.goal: Teach the IB concept: the child used their imagination to think about what someone else might feel and dream — that's the magic of Reflection (thinking about thinking). Plant a curiosity seed for next time.
closing.constraint: T0 max 2 sentences, name Reflection naturally connected to what they experienced, warm goodbye

early_exit.goal: Gentle goodbye — the cat is still dreaming happily, they can peek at more dreams anytime
early_exit.constraint: T0 max 2 sentences, no pressure to continue
